uniqueAngle.existingConsensus: Deal reviews are a management ritual — pipeline meetings, CRM hygiene, and manager-run inspection cadences.
uniqueAngle.keelClaim: A deal review's value comes from the rep interrogating their own deal before anyone else does — the manager meeting is the performance; the private reflection is the work.
uniqueAngle.supportingReason: Reps already know where their deals are soft. What's missing is a structured moment to say it honestly — and manager-run reviews actively discourage that, because performing confidence is rational when your thinking is being scored.

beliefShift: The reader stops treating deal review as a meeting that happens to them and starts a short private interrogation habit after every significant call.
originalAsset: A named seven-question deal-reflection framework, presented as a usable checklist the reader can run in five minutes.
